g.text: GPIO0 = face-press switch = BOOT strap: hold the face during a reset (pulse EN: TP7 RST or Tag-Connect pin 2) to enter download mode; plugging USB resets the chip only when no cell is fitted.

g.desc: GPIO0 = face-press switch = BOOT strap: hold the face during a reset (pulse EN: TP7 RST or Tag-Connect pin 2) to enter download mode; plugging USB resets the chip only when no cell is fitted.

g.text: GPIO45 (VDD_SPI strap) reads 0 at reset through the backlight driver EN pull-down; on this PSRAM module the flash voltage is fixed by eFuse (WROOM-1 datasheet section 8), so the strap only has to be defined. GPIO46 (download-boot strap) is NC with its internal pull-down.

g.desc: GPIO45 (VDD_SPI strap) reads 0 at reset through the backlight driver EN pull-down; on this PSRAM module the flash voltage is fixed by eFuse (WROOM-1 datasheet section 8), so the strap only has to be defined. GPIO46 (download-boot strap) is NC with its internal pull-down.

g.text: Expander TCA6408A outputs are high-Z until firmware writes them: every default is set by the resistors shown.
